# RANKMAKER

> RANKMAKER creates accurate ordered rankings through quick head-to-head choices instead of tier-list buckets.

People can rank official or community templates, create their own templates, and share the resulting ordered lists. Guest rankings can run locally without an account; social and creator features require sign-in.

## Product guide

- [RANKMAKER overview](https://rankmaker.net/index.md): Concise, LLM-friendly explanation of the ranking method, features, audiences, and limits.
- [Explore ranking templates](https://rankmaker.net/search): Search and browse public templates for movies, music, games, sports, and other subjects.
- [Create a template](https://rankmaker.net/create): Build a custom set of options for other people to rank.
- [About RANKMAKER](https://rankmaker.net/about): The product's origin and purpose.
